nativeZh: n. 百忧解（一种治疗精神抑郁的药物）

senses.en: a selective-serotonin reuptake inhibitor commonly prescribed as an antidepressant (trade names Prozac or Sarafem); it is thought to work by increasing the activity of serotonin in the brain
